question: Why did the approval rate for debit cards in Colombia drop on 13 August 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_drop_impact('CO', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-13 14:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-14 12:10:00', 'debit')
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_approval_drivers('CO', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-13 14:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-14 12:10:00', 'debit') ORDER BY abs(total_effect_pp) DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_decline_shift('CO', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-13 14:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-14 12:10:00', 'debit') ORDER BY abs(delta_pp) DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_cascade_health('CO', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-13 14:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-14 12:10:00', 'debit') ORDER BY window_failures DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_changes_near('CO', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-13 14:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-08-14 12:10:00', 240)

facts.K1: The drop started around 14:00 local time on 13 August 2026.
facts.K2: A routing change (v14, CHG-0813) sent all Colombian domestic debit traffic to Acquirer B.
facts.K3: Acquirer B approves Colombian debit much worse than A did; 'Do not honor' (05) declines from B grew sharply.
facts.K4: B's 'Do not honor' (R05) declines were not retried on another acquirer because mapping v2.3 classified them as hard / non-retryable.
facts.K5: Impact: final approval fell about 11 pp versus the 14-day baseline (about 86.5% to 75.6%), about 110 lost approvals and about USD 6.4k of lost approved volume in the window.
facts.K6: Resolution: routing rollback on 14 August around 12:10 local (CHG-0814) and/or mapping hotfix v2.3.1 on 15 August (CHG-0815).

facts.K2: End: 14 August 2026 at about 12:10 Bogota time, when routing was rolled back (anything between 12:00 and 13:00).

question: Why did Acquirer B stop recovering 'do not honor' declines through cascading after 6 August 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT business_date, country, acquirer_id, first_reason_code, failures, cascade_rate, baseline_cascade_rate, mapping_versions, is_alert FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_cascade_alerts_daily WHERE acquirer_id = 'B' AND first_reason_code = '05' AND business_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-08-03' AND DATE'2026-08-18' ORDER BY business_date, country
SELECT change_id, changed_at_utc, description FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_change_log WHERE change_type = 'decline_mapping'

facts.K1: Decline-code mapping v2.3 for Acquirer B (CHG-0806, 6 August) classified R05 'do not honor' as a hard / non-retryable decline.
facts.K2: As a result, B's 05 declines stopped being retried on another acquirer: the cascade rate fell from about 100% to about 0% in Mexico and Colombia.
facts.K3: It lasted until the mapping hotfix v2.3.1 on 15 August (CHG-0815).

question: What happened to approvals in Brazil on the morning of 21 July 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT issuer_id, sum(payments_sent) AS payments_sent, round(sum(final_approved) / sum(payments_sent), 4) AS final_approval_rate FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_issuer_daily WHERE country = 'BR' AND business_date = DATE'2026-07-21' GROUP BY issuer_id ORDER BY final_approval_rate
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_decline_shift('BR', TIMESTAMP'2026-07-21 09:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-07-21 12:00:00') ORDER BY abs(delta_pp) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM workspace.approval_copilot.fn_changes_near('BR', TIMESTAMP'2026-07-21 09:00:00', TIMESTAMP'2026-07-21 12:00:00', 24)

facts.K1: Issuer BR-ISS-03 was unavailable (code 91, issuer or switch unavailable) roughly 09:00-12:00 Sao Paulo time; its approvals collapsed.
facts.K2: It was issuer-side (it hit all acquirers), so cascading to another acquirer could not recover it; a partner notice (EXT-0721) had announced maintenance.
facts.K3: Overall Brazil impact was limited to those hours and that issuer.

question: Why did conversion in Brazil fall on 18 and 19 June 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT business_date, sum(payment_intents) AS intents, round(sum(blocked_by_risk) / sum(payment_intents), 4) AS risk_block_rate, round(sum(approved) / sum(payment_intents), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_funnel_daily WHERE country = 'BR' AND business_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-06-15' AND DATE'2026-06-22' GROUP BY business_date ORDER BY business_date
SELECT change_id, changed_at_sao_paulo, description FROM workspace.approval_copilot.gold_change_log WHERE change_type = 'risk_rules'

facts.K1: Risk rules v3 (CHG-0618, 18 June) raised risk blocks from about 1% to about 3-4% of payment intents.
facts.K2: Authorization approval itself did not drop; the loss was before the acquirer (risk blocks). Rules were tuned in v3.1 on 20 June (CHG-0620) and blocks went back to normal.

question: Was there any early warning before the Colombia debit incident of 13 August 2026?
